thread:
Cass: Kickoff for ClinicLink customer spotlight + launch webinar. Need interview slots, single-line benchmark for the blog, final quote signoff from their VP of Product, legal embargo date, and a consent blurb for the registration form. Can we wrap by next Wed?

Omar: I can handle scheduling. Recommend 20m slots Tue/Wed midday PT. Tentatively holding Wed 11:00 for VP Product. Sending invites now.

Riley: For the benchmark, can we run a small anonymized EHR prompt sweep on staging (5k tokens total across varied prompts)? Will output median token latency and a one-line stat like "~2.4x median latency improvement in our tests" with an appendix link. Need customer OK to run.

Mina: Assets needed: 1) pull quote (final), 2) two headshots, 3) company logo (SVG + PNG), 4) 3 social soundbites (15s). Also request a 30s clip for webinar promo. I can mock hero images once quote is final.

Cass: Draft pull quote for review:
```
"Redwoodhelped us move to near-real-time patient summaries, reducing triage friction across teams."
```

legal-bot: Quick guidance: add attribution "in our tests" for any perf claim and avoid absolutes. Recommend swapping "reducing triage friction" for "helping reduce triage time". Also ensure no PHI appears in transcript or assets. Typical review 48-72h.

Cass: Updated per legal: "In our tests, Redwood helped us move to near-real-time patient summaries, helping reduce triage time across teams." Legal, can you confirm?

legal-bot: Approve with tiny wording tweak: change "patient" -> "care" for broader language and to avoid PHI implications. Final approved line: "In our tests, Redwood helped us move to near-real-time care summaries, helping reduce triage time across teams." Marking green pending customer signoff.

Riley: Scheduling perf run Thu 08:00 PT. Will upload appendix and recommended one-line stat here after run.

Omar: Invites sent with a media consent checkbox and an embargo request field. Customer asked for embargo to the 17th; noting that.

ops-bot: Lead routing note: utm_campaign=cliniclink_launch; tag=cliniclink-case; leads -> /queues/enterprise-sdr. Consent param saved as consent_marketing=true. :gear:

Riley: Perf results: median token latency 105ms vs 255ms baseline -> "~2.4x median latency improvement in our tests." Appendix: https://app.internal/benchmarks/cliniclink-1819997777. Recommend single-line stat: "~2.4x median latency improvement (in our tests)."

Mina: Uploaded placeholder hero and social frames. Holding final creative until headshots + final quote attached.

Cass: Customer requested one small edit: replace "triage time" with "time to triage decision." Updated quote: "In our tests, Redwood helped us move to near-real-time care summaries, helping reduce time to triage decision across teams."

legal-bot: That phrasing is fine. Add methodology blurb on the landing page (environment, sample size). Embargo 17th cleared from legal side if no further redlines.

Omar: I'll attach interview transcripts and request headshots in the invite. Planning to confirm final publish package Mon morning.

Cass: Action list: schedule & transcripts (Omar), perf stat + appendix (Riley), legal signoff (legal-bot), consent copy & form (Omar), assets & social drafts (Mina), lead routing (ops-bot). Thanks team ":thumbsup:"

Mina: I'll queue social drafts and a 30s webinar promo clip to be ready once quote + headshots are final.

Cass: Great. Follow-up Monday AM for final checks.
